source_text: Where did you get that artifact?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx#>.Where did you get that artifact?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx#>.Where did you get that artifact?"

translation: Skąd masz ten artefakt?

source_text: It was stolen. That doesn’t look good for you…

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.It was stolen. That doesn’t look good for you…
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.It was stolen. That doesn’t look good for you…"

translation: Został skradziony. To nie stawia cię w dobrym świetle…

source_text: Unless there’s some good reason that you’d have a stolen artifact.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Unless there’s some good reason that you’d have a stolen artifact.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Unless there’s some good reason that you’d have a stolen artifact."

translation: Chyba że masz dobry powód, by posiadać skradziony artefakt.

source_text: I didn’t know it was stolen. Good enough reason for you?

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.I didn’t know it was stolen. Good enough reason for you?
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.I didn’t know it was stolen. Good enough reason for you?"

translation: Nie wiedziałam, że jest kradziony. Wystarczy ci taki powód?

source_text: Just tell me where you got it. Did you know you were buying from a Guild member?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Just tell me where you got it. Did you know you were buying from a Guild member?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Just tell me where you got it. Did you know you were buying from a Guild member?"

translation: Po prostu powiedz, skąd go masz. Wiedziałaś, że kupujesz go od członka Gildii?

source_text: I didn’t buy it from a Guild member.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.I didn’t buy it from a Guild member.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.I didn’t buy it from a Guild member."

translation: Nie kupiłam go od członka Gildii.

source_text: So, you know who the Eclipse Guild is.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.So, you know who the Eclipse Guild is.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.So, you know who the Eclipse Guild is."

translation: Czyli wiesz, czym jest Gildia Zaćmienia.

source_text: You’re making a mistake. You need to let me go.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.You’re making a mistake. You need to let me go.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.You’re making a mistake. You need to let me go."

translation: Popełniasz błąd. Musisz mnie wypuścić.

source_text: That’s not going to happen.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.That’s not going to happen.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.That’s not going to happen."

translation: Nic z tego.

source_text: I wouldn’t be so sure about that.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.I wouldn’t be so sure about that.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.I wouldn’t be so sure about that."

translation: Nie byłabym tego taka pewna.

source_text: We know the Guild is operating in North Santiva.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.We know the Guild is operating in North Santiva.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.We know the Guild is operating in North Santiva."

translation: Wiemy, że Gildia działa w North Santiva.

source_text: Really, Sherlock? They operate everywhere.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.Really, Sherlock? They operate everywhere.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.Really, Sherlock? They operate everywhere."

translation: Naprawdę, Sherlocku? Działają wszędzie.

source_text: But something special is happening here…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.But something special is happening here…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.But something special is happening here…"

translation: Ale tutaj dzieje się coś szczególnego…

source_text: Something involving Duncan and Charles. Right, miss?

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Something involving Duncan and Charles. Right, miss?
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Something involving Duncan and Charles. Right, miss?"

translation: Coś z udziałem Duncana i Charlesa. Zgadza się, panno?

source_text: You’re pretty good at this, aren’t you, detective?

structure.raw_value: NeFlDe.You’re pretty good at this, aren’t you, detective?
structure.script_literal: "NeFlDe.You’re pretty good at this, aren’t you, detective?"

translation: Całkiem nieźle ci idzie, detektywie.

source_text: Call me 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Call me 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Call me 1Hero."

translation: Mów mi 1Hero.

source_text: I assume you know who I am.

structure.raw_value: NeFlOp.I assume you know who I am.
structure.script_literal: "NeFlOp.I assume you know who I am."

translation: Zakładam, że wiesz, kim jestem.

source_text: Seriously. You don’t have my file?

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.Seriously. You don’t have my file?
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.Seriously. You don’t have my file?"

translation: Serio? Nie masz moich akt?

source_text: Your name is Nellie.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Your name is Nellie.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Your name is Nellie."

translation: Nazywasz się Nellie.

source_text: Don’t play dumb, 1Hero. I’m Nellie Cole, world famous escape artist.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.Don’t play dumb, 1Hero. I’m Nellie Cole, world famous escape artist.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.Don’t play dumb, 1Hero. I’m Nellie Cole, world famous escape artist."

translation: Nie udawaj głupiego, 1Hero. Jestem Nellie Cole, słynną na całym świecie mistrzynią ucieczek.

source_text: Escape artist?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Escape artist?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Escape artist?"

translation: Mistrzynią ucieczek?

source_text: You seriously don’t know, do you?

structure.raw_value: NeAnOp.You seriously don’t know, do you?
structure.script_literal: "NeAnOp.You seriously don’t know, do you?"

translation: Naprawdę nie wiesz, prawda?

source_text: I’m new here. Why don’t you tell me?

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I’m new here. Why don’t you tell me?
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I’m new here. Why don’t you tell me?"

translation: Jestem tu nowy. Może mi opowiesz?

source_text: I broke out of Sanibel prison back in the day. But I’m a free woman now.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx.I broke out of Sanibel prison back in the day. But I’m a free woman now.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx.I broke out of Sanibel prison back in the day. But I’m a free woman now."

translation: Kiedyś uciekłam z więzienia Sanibel. Ale teraz jestem wolną kobietą.

source_text: Oh, yeah. You were on the news. I remember you.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Oh, yeah. You were on the news. I remember you.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Oh, yeah. You were on the news. I remember you."

translation: A, tak. Byłaś w wiadomościach. Pamiętam cię.

source_text: Star struck, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: NeFlOp.Star struck, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "NeFlOp.Star struck, 1Hero?"

translation: Onieśmielony, 1Hero?

source_text: You expect me to believe you came across a stolen artifact and had no idea you were dealing with hot goods?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.You expect me to believe you came across a stolen artifact and had no idea you were dealing with hot goods?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.You expect me to believe you came across a stolen artifact and had no idea you were dealing with hot goods?"

translation: Mam uwierzyć, że znalazłaś skradziony artefakt i nie wiedziałaś, że handlujesz trefnym towarem?

source_text: I don’t expect you to believe anything. Trust me, 1Hero…

structure.raw_value: NeAnOp.I don’t expect you to believe anything. Trust me, 1Hero…
structure.script_literal: "NeAnOp.I don’t expect you to believe anything. Trust me, 1Hero…"

translation: Nie oczekuję, że w cokolwiek uwierzysz. Zaufaj mi, 1Hero…

source_text: I am going to walk right out of this station.

structure.raw_value: NeFlEx.I am going to walk right out of this station.
structure.script_literal: "NeFlEx.I am going to walk right out of this station."

translation: Po prostu wyjdę z tego komisariatu.

source_text: You have a lot of confidence in your abilities.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.You have a lot of confidence in your abilities.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.You have a lot of confidence in your abilities."

translation: Bardzo wierzysz w swoje umiejętności.

source_text: This has nothing to do with my skill set.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx.This has nothing to do with my skill set.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx.This has nothing to do with my skill set."

translation: Nie chodzi o moje umiejętności.

source_text: There’s a lot you don’t know about what I’m doing here in North Santiva.

structure.raw_value: NeAnOp.There’s a lot you don’t know about what I’m doing here in North Santiva.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnOp.There’s a lot you don’t know about what I’m doing here in North Santiva."

translation: Nie wiesz zbyt wiele o tym, co robię tutaj, w North Santiva.

source_text: But in time… You will see.

structure.raw_value: NeBaDe.But in time… You will see.
structure.script_literal: "NeBaDe.But in time… You will see."

translation: Ale z czasem… Zobaczysz.

source_text: Since it seems my time with you will be short, why don’t you answer a few questions.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Since it seems my time with you will be short, why don’t you answer a few questions.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Since it seems my time with you will be short, why don’t you answer a few questions."

translation: Skoro mam spędzić z tobą niewiele czasu, może odpowiesz na kilka pytań.

source_text: What connection did Charles Wilkes have with the Eclipse Guild?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What connection did Charles Wilkes have with the Eclipse Guild?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.What connection did Charles Wilkes have with the Eclipse Guild?"

translation: Co łączyło Charlesa Wilkesa z Gildią Zaćmienia?

source_text: And why would you think I know anything about the Eclipse Guild hierarchy?

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.And why would you think I know anything about the Eclipse Guild hierarchy?
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.And why would you think I know anything about the Eclipse Guild hierarchy?"

translation: A dlaczego miałbyś sądzić, że wiem cokolwiek o hierarchii Gildii Zaćmienia?

source_text: If I were to guess… and I’m usually right about these things…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.If I were to guess… and I’m usually right about these things…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.If I were to guess… and I’m usually right about these things…"

translation: Gdybym miał zgadywać… a zwykle dobrze mi to wychodzi…

source_text: You’re an Eclipse Guild member yourself. A thief for hire, maybe?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.You’re an Eclipse Guild member yourself. A thief for hire, maybe?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.You’re an Eclipse Guild member yourself. A thief for hire, maybe?"

translation: Sama należysz do Gildii Zaćmienia. Może jesteś złodziejką do wynajęcia?

source_text: Wrong. Try again.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.Wrong. Try again.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.Wrong. Try again."

translation: Nie. Spróbuj jeszcze raz.
